scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the started laser-cut movement tray job during the reserved makerspace slot for tonight's foam-fit skirmish case.
Emerging Need: The cut file reaches the live cutter queue, but the same job pauses because the cutter lacks a material profile and cannot start.
Decision Context: Early records show only scheduling and checkout; the usable stock profile is recorded in bench plans, while shop status later defines a brief hold.
Consequence: If the profile is not available while the hold remains open, the queued file is cleared and today's tray cannot be cut.

parameter.title: Laser bay slot for movement tray
parameter.description: Reserved cutter time for a custom skirmish movement tray from the prepared CutPath file.

parameter.subject: Laser bay upload link for today's tray slot
parameter.body: Your 2:00 PM laser bay reservation is open for uploads. Files accepted into the queue will run only after preflight confirms a material profile on the job record.

parameter.description: Draft cutter-use charge for uploaded movement tray job TRAY-447; final charge waits for successful preflight.

parameter.subject: TRAY-447 paused in laser preflight
parameter.body: CutPath file TRAY-447 is in the live queue, but the cutter cannot start because the job record has no material profile selected. The file is held temporarily; cutting remains disabled until a profile is set.

parameter.content: I'm by the bay board. TRAY-447 still shows paused for material profile, and the operator's hold timer runs out at 2:25. Walk-in jobs are already stacked, so release would mean no same-afternoon rerun.

parameter.subject: TRAY-447 released from today's queue
parameter.body: The material-profile hold expired for TRAY-447, so the queued file was cleared and the cutter slot was released. Today's remaining laser bay queue is full.
